content: Can you route the batch_11 complaints? Product and issue from the taxonomy, compliance flags with quotes, and a quick note on anything I should look at first.
I'll read the taxonomy and then the batch.

# Complaint triage taxonomy for the Bank.
# Each complaint receives exactly one product and one issue from this file.

version: 3
products:
  - product: Checking/Savings
    issues:
      - Account opening or closing
      - Deposits and withdrawals
      - Overdraft or NSF fees
      - Transfers and automatic payments
      - Account access or frozen funds

  - product: Credit card
    issues:
      - Billing dispute
      - Unauthorized charge
      - Fees or interest
      - Credit limit change
      - Rewards

  - product: Mortgage
    issues:
      - Payment processing or escrow
      - Late fees
      - Loan modification or forbearance
      - Servicing transfer
      - Closing costs

  - product: Auto loan
    issues:
      - Payment problem
      - Repossession
      - Add-on products or GAP coverage
      - Payoff or title release

  - product: Personal loan
    issues:
      - Application or denial
      - Payment problem
      - Fees or interest
      - Payoff

  - product: Debt collection
    issues:
      - Debt not owed
      - Communication tactics
      - Validation or verification
      - Credit reporting of collected debt

  - product: Other/escalate
    issues:
      - Needs human review

complaint_id,date_received,channel,narrative
C-1101,2026-10-08,Web,"My mortgage payment is set up to come out of my Bank checking account automatically on the 1st. In September the autopay just didn't run. No email, no alert, nothing. The money was sitting in my checking the whole time, $2,960, I can show the balance. On September 18 I got a $64 late fee on my mortgage and a letter saying I'm past due. The checking side says the mortgage side has to fix it and the mortgage side says it's a checking problem. I'm stuck in the middle."
C-1102,2026-10-08,Phone,"I redeemed 40,000 points for a $400 airline gift card in August. Never got the code. The rewards site shows the points as used. I've called three times and they keep opening a new ticket."
C-1103,2026-10-09,Web,"I have overdraft protection linked to my savings, and there was $1,200 in savings. On October 2 I still got a $35 overdraft fee because the transfer from savings failed. Nobody can tell me why it failed."
C-1104,2026-10-09,Mail,A collector says I owe $640 for a checking account overdraft from 2019. I did not have an account with the Bank in 2019. I opened my first account with you in 2022. I have asked them to stop.
C-1105,2026-10-10,Phone,"After my car was repossessed I got a notice saying I still owe $6,800 because it sold at auction for $3,100. That car was worth at least $9,000, it had brand new tires. How does a car sell for a third of what it's worth?"
